key_points: UBS Group lowered price target on Goldman Sachs (GS), adding downward pressure
Goldman Sachs bans traders and bankers from using certain AI tools, raising operational risk concerns
Heritage Investors Management Corp reduced its position in GS, signaling reduced long-term confidence
Bank Julius Baer and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group increased shares, but these buy orders are relatively small compared to overall market sentiment
Multiple sell orders from smaller entities (BOCHK, MGO One Seven LLC) add minor bearish pressure
